As it stands, we have a 55-minute picture with draft title card and end credits, and the delivery folder currently contains a stereo master, optional subtitle files, and a generic principal-credit block. Before I can lock the package, I need sign-off from each of you on your respective areas — standards, business affairs, and accessibility. Let's go through one at a time. Could each sign-off owner report your requirement and current status? We'll record any needed actions as commitments and then either lock or hold the package before we wrap today.
